weaknesses: The abstract could better clarify the significance of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition in relation to the main results.
Numerical experiments lack a comprehensive comparison with existing methods to highlight the advantages of the proposed approach.
strengths: The paper establishes a rigorous mathematical foundation connecting deep residual networks and neural ODEs.
The results are supported by both theoretical proofs and numerical experiments, demonstrating the practical implications of the findings.
The exploration of implicit regularization provides valuable insights into the training dynamics of deep residual networks.
